Specification: This specification models a single state variable, myVariable, as a function from the singleton process set P to subsets of integers. The initial state sets myVariable to map every element of P to the singleton set {0}, and the only step relation rewrites myVariable to that same function regardless of the chosen process parameter p. The spec also defines a type-correctness predicate asserting that myVariable is a function from P to subsets of integers, but it does not define a full temporal specification, fairness condition, or verified temporal property.
